# Pre-judgment & Post-judgment Interest Rates

_Updated July 2026_

The following table sets out the cash rates for the calculation of pre-judgment interest[1](https://www.fedcourt.gov.au/forms-and-fees/interest-rates#f1) and post-judgment interest.[2](https://www.fedcourt.gov.au/forms-and-fees/interest-rates#f2)

The [Interest on Judgments Practice Note](https://www.fedcourt.gov.au/law-and-practice/practice-documents/practice-notes/gpn-int) (GPN-INT) provides guidance in regard to interest on judgments arising under sections 51A and 52 of the _[Federal Court of Australia Act 1976](https://www.legislation.gov.au/Series/C2004A01586)_ (Cth) and rule 39.06 of the [Federal Court Rules 2011](https://www.legislation.gov.au/Series/F2011L01551) (Cth). It also provides guidance in regard to interest up to judgment arising under s 547 of the [_Fair Work Act 2009_](http://www.legislation.gov.au/Series/C2009A00028) (Cth).

**Note:** Before relying on the information in this table for any purpose, including in calculating pre-judgment and post-judgment interest, users should independently verify its accuracy, currency and completeness. Authoritative details of the cash rate, published by the Reserve Bank of Australia from time to time, are available on the Bank's [website](http://www.rba.gov.au/statistics/cash-rate).
